stored_not_analysed_note: One forward pass returns all nine heads, so all nine are stored to avoid a re-run. Only `analysed_heads` are analysed and reported; the rest are stored but not analysed, and no figure, claim or validation covers them.
delta_definition: prediction(single-base mutant) - prediction(wild type), per head, at delta[row, position, base, head]
scale_note: Deltas and `wt_prediction` are fractions of 1, the scale v3 was trained on and `predictions.csv` reports; the split's label columns are raw percentages.
reference_slot_note: The reference base's slot is exactly 0 and that zero is true, not a sentinel: substituting a base for itself changes nothing. `reference_base` gives the reference slot per row and position, so the zero stays distinguishable from a measured no-effect.
base_axis_note: ACGT in fixed order at every position, so the base axis means the same thing in every row and a PAM base can be indexed directly (ADR 0007 assigns base-resolution PAM work to ISM).
wt_prediction_note: The wild-type prediction per row and head, on the same scale as `predictions.csv`. It joins by `row_index` and is the check that catches a mis-join, instead of a mis-join surfacing as a result.
row_index_note: int64, aligned to axis 0 and strictly ascending. The only identity between this artifact and the 400-row IG one.
resume_note: The sweep runs in row shards, each written to a checkpoint directory as it completes; `reused_shards` are the shards this run read back rather than recomputed.
